highlights: Net Income (Loss) Per Share Attributable to Tyson $ (0.22) $ 0.13 $ 1.28 $ 1.33

quotes.text: Our performance in fiscal 2026 reflects the strength of our diversified multiprotein model and our dedication to our customers and consumers.
quotes.by: Jeff Schomburger, President and CEO of Tyson Foods

outlook: We anticipate segment operating income (loss), as adjusted, of $(300) million to $100 million in fiscal 2027.
We anticipate segment operating income, as adjusted, of $75 million to $175 million in fiscal 2027.
We anticipate segment operating income, as adjusted, of $1.3 billion to $1.6 billion in fiscal 2027.
We anticipate segment operating income, as adjusted, of $1.25 billion to $1.4 billion in fiscal 2027.

items.heading: Fluctuations in commodity prices and in the availability of raw materials, especially feed grains, live cattle, live swine and other inputs, could negatively impact our earnings.
The prices we receive for our products may fluctuate due to competition from other food producers and processors.
Disease outbreaks can adversely impact our ability to conduct our operations and the supply and demand for our products.
Changes in consumer preference and failure to maintain favorable consumer perception of our brands and products could negatively impact our business.

We may not realize any or all of the anticipated benefits of our network optimization plan, or any other financial or operational optimization plans, which may prove to be more difficult, costly or time-consuming than expected.

We are subject to risks associated with our international activities, which could negatively affect our sales to customers in foreign locations, as well as our operations and assets in such locations and in the United States.
